title: Control Plane ProposalVersion
description: Immutable validation report for one exact ConfigurationVersion (S2-1/S2-3). It binds the configuration digest and the RequirementsVersion digest to the deterministic findings that justify accepting, acknowledging or rejecting the configuration, and derives its state from them: blocked exactly when a blocking error is present, ready otherwise. Findings are content-addressed and sorted by (severity, target, code, message, finding_id).

configuration_ref.description: The exact ConfigurationVersion this report analyses; the digest is what an approval binds to.

validator_set.description: Rule-set identifier; changing a rule must bump it, so findings and rules cannot drift apart.

registry_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the registry document as read (an input fingerprint, never an identity or a substitute for registry facts); null when the registry could not be read.

findings.description: Deterministic findings, sorted by (severity, target, code, message, finding_id) and de-duplicated by finding_id.

code.description: Frozen code registry: a code keeps its meaning forever.

severity.description: error = blocking, cannot be acknowledged; warning = requires an explicit acknowledgement; info = informational.

finding_id.description: Content address: the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the finding content.

state.description: Derived, never hand-set: blocked exactly when a blocking error is present.
